theorems.name: Submission.cbr_bim_extension_mass_bounds
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U C : Set (Euclid P)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)), IsOpen U → IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → Y.support ⊆ C → Y.mass ≤ (Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U)).mass ∧ Y.boundary.mass ≤ (Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U)).boundary.mass
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
